57/**
58 * @brief Used to explicitly enable or disable contact between links in a bot. By default, all bots
59 * will spawn with contact disabled between links and their first ancestor with a physics body not
60 * connected via a Hard joint. This structure can be used to either reenable contact on those
61 * pairs, or disable contact between links that are not strictly child-parent. Overrides are applied
62 * on bot link actors after spawn using @ref Scene::EnableActorContactSymmetric.
63 *
64 * @see BotPrefab::contactOverrides, Scene::EnableActorContactSymmetric
65 */
66struct BotContactOverride {
67 DynamicString linkA; // The first link in the pair.
68 DynamicString linkB; // The second link in the pair.
69 bool enable = false; // Should contact between the pair be enabled?
70
71 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotContactOverride)
72 MOCHI_FIELD(linkA)
73 MOCHI_FIELD(linkB)
74 MOCHI_FIELD(enable)
75 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
76};

78/**
79 * @brief Parameters describing a single joint in a bot.
80 */
81struct BotJointPrefab : superdex::prefab::ArticulatedJointPrefab {
82 /* @brief Maximum effort magnitude that may be applied to actuate this joint
83 * [N·m for revolute, N for prismatic]. Interpreted by regime: a negative value (default
84 * @ref kEffortUnbounded) is unbounded; @c 0 is non-actuated (no effort can be applied, though the
85 * joint still moves freely within its range under external forces); a positive value is a finite
86 * limit. This is advisory metadata — it is not copied into the physics articulation, so the sim
87 * enforces nothing on its own; controllers may read it (e.g. to clamp their output). */
88 real effortLimit = kEffortUnbounded;
89
90#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
91 bool operator==(BotJointPrefab const& rhs) const = default;
92#endif
93
94 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotJointPrefab)
95 MOCHI_BASE_CLASS(superdex::prefab::ArticulatedJointPrefab)
96 MOCHI_FIELD(effortLimit) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
97 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
98};

100/**
101 * @brief Parameters describing a single sensor in a bot.
102 */
103struct BotSensorPrefab {
104 /* Registered sensor type (e.g., "SENSOR_CAMERA"). */
105 DynamicString type;
106
107 /* Human-readable, findable identifier for this sensor instance. */
108 DynamicString name;
109
110 /* Sensor pose relative to the associated link's actor (aFromB convention: maps sensor-frame
111 * coordinates into the link frame). Chain to world via SensorBase::GetWorldTransform. */
112 TransformRT parentFromSensor;
113
114 /* Sensor parameters: a path to a .superdex_sensor JSON file or inline JSON. Empty uses
115 * defaults. */
116 DynamicString params;
117
118 // --- LEGACY (remove once all .superdex_bot assets use `type`/`params`) ---
119 // Older assets named these fields `typeName`/`paramsFile`. These capture the old keys on load;
120 // ApplyLegacyBotSensorFields folds them into type/params and clears them (so re-saves omit them).
121 // TODO(superdex): delete these fields, the MOCHI_FIELD_NAME lines, and
122 // ApplyLegacyBotSensorFields.
123 /* @brief Legacy key captured on load: older assets named this field @c typeName. Folded into
124 * @c type by @ref ApplyLegacyBotSensorFields and cleared (so re-saves omit it). */
125 DynamicString _legacyTypeName;
126 /* @brief Legacy key captured on load: older assets named this field @c paramsFile. Folded into
127 * @c params by @ref ApplyLegacyBotSensorFields and cleared (so re-saves omit it). */
128 DynamicString _legacyParamsFile;
129
130#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
131 bool operator==(BotSensorPrefab const& rhs) const = default;
132#endif
133
134 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotSensorPrefab)
135 MOCHI_FIELD(type)
136 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
137 MOCHI_FIELD(parentFromSensor) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
138 MOCHI_FIELD(params) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(JsonString) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
139 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyTypeName, "typeName") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
140 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyParamsFile, "paramsFile") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
141 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
142};

201/**
202 * @brief Common parameters for bot transmissions (linear transmissions and spatial tendons).
203 *
204 * @details Holds fields shared by transmission-like actuators that couple joint DOFs
205 * via a displacement-control actuator. Provides the display name and inherits actuator tuning
206 * parameters from @ref superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams.
207 */
208struct BotTransmissionPrefab : superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams {
209 /* @brief Human-readable label (used by the editor UI; not consumed by the runtime API). */
210 DynamicString name;
211
212#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
213 bool operator==(BotTransmissionPrefab const& rhs) const = default;
214#endif
215
216 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotTransmissionPrefab)
217 MOCHI_BASE_CLASS(superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams)
218 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
219 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
220};

222/**
223 * @brief Parameters describing a single linear transmission attached to a bot.
224 *
225 * @details Mirrors @ref superdex::experimental::LinearTransmissionParams with an added
226 * display @ref name field and SReflect markup so it can live inside @ref BotPrefab
227 * and round-trip through the bot's JSON serialization. The three joint arrays
228 * (@ref jointIndices, @ref jointCoefficients, @ref jointAxisDisps)
229 * must always be the same length, with one entry
230 * per joint the transmission traverses. The remaining fields are inherited from
231 * @ref BotTransmissionPrefab which inherits
232 * @ref superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams so that one
233 * displacement-control actuator can be configured alongside each transmission.
234 */
235struct BotLinearTransmissionPrefab : BotTransmissionPrefab {
236 /* @brief Indices into @ref BotPrefab::joints identifying which joints the
237 * transmission traverses. */
238 DynamicArray<int> jointIndices;
239
240 /* @brief Transmission Jacobian entry at each joint [m / joint-DoF units for a
241 * tendon, dimensionless for a gearbox]. Sign encodes direction: positive if
242 * the transmission displacement increases with the joint DoF, negative if it
243 * decreases. */
244 DynamicArray<real> jointCoefficients;
245
246 /* @brief Displacement along the joint axis [m] for the transmission attachment
247 * point at each joint. This allows the transmission to be offset from the joint
248 * origin along the axis. */
249 DynamicArray<real> jointAxisDisps;
250
251#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
252 bool operator==(BotLinearTransmissionPrefab const& rhs) const = default;
253#endif
254
255 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotLinearTransmissionPrefab)
256 MOCHI_BASE_CLASS(superdex::robotics::BotTransmissionPrefab)
257 MOCHI_FIELD(jointIndices)
258 MOCHI_FIELD(jointCoefficients)
259 MOCHI_FIELD(jointAxisDisps)
260 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
261};

263/**
264 * @brief Parameters describing a single spatial tendon attached to a bot.
265 *
266 * @details Mirrors @ref superdex::experimental::SpatialTendonParams with an added
267 * display @ref name field and SReflect markup so it can live inside @ref BotPrefab
268 * and round-trip through the bot's JSON serialization. The ordered
269 * @ref routingElements list defines waypoint and linear-joint elements traversed by the
270 * tendon. The remaining fields are inherited from @ref BotTransmissionPrefab which inherits
271 * @ref superdex::experimental::DisplacementControlActuatorParams so that one
272 * displacement-control actuator can be configured alongside each tendon.
273 */
274struct BotSpatialTendonPrefab : BotTransmissionPrefab {
275 /* @brief Ordered routing elements defining the tendon path. Must contain at least
276 * one element, and every waypoint must be adjacent to another waypoint. */
277 DynamicArray<RoutingElement> routingElements;
278
279#if MOCHI_LANGUAGE_CPP20
280 bool operator==(BotSpatialTendonPrefab const& rhs) const = default;
281#endif
282
283 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotSpatialTendonPrefab)
284 MOCHI_BASE_CLASS(superdex::robotics::BotTransmissionPrefab)
285 MOCHI_FIELD(routingElements)
286 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
287};

289/**
290 * @brief Complete parameter set for a bot.
291 */
292struct BotPrefab {
293 /// Bot name.
294 DynamicString name;
295
296 /// Joint parameters for each joint in the articulation.
297 DynamicArray<BotJointPrefab> joints;
298
299 /// Link parameters for each link in the articulation.
300 DynamicArray<BotLinkPrefab> links;
301
302 /// Transform from the root link to the world frame.
303 TransformRT worldFromRoot;
304
305 /// Default pose (array of joint DOF angles/translations) used when spawning the bot.
306 DynamicArray<real> defaultPose;
307
308 /// Linear transmissions that couple multiple joint DOFs via per-joint coefficients. Each entry
309 /// produces one @ref superdex::experimental::LinearTransmissionParams at instantiation time.
310 DynamicArray<BotLinearTransmissionPrefab> linearTransmissions;
311
312 /// Spatial tendons routed through waypoint and linear-joint elements. Each entry
313 /// produces one @ref superdex::experimental::SpatialTendonParams at instantiation time.
314 DynamicArray<BotSpatialTendonPrefab> spatialTendons;
315
316 /// Array of link-link contact override pairs.
317 DynamicArray<BotContactOverride> contactOverrides;
318
319 /// Cycle-closing joints for closed-loop mechanisms (e.g. four-bar linkages, parallel grippers).
320 /// Each entry becomes one @ref superdex::ArticulatedActorParams::cycles entry at instantiation time.
321 /// Link references (@ref superdex::ArticulatedCycleJointParams::parentLink /
322 /// @ref superdex::ArticulatedCycleJointParams::childLink) are int indices into @ref links.
323 DynamicArray<ArticulatedCycleJointParams> cycles;
324
325 // [Internal] The number of DOFs; computed at runtime by RebuildBotData; DO NOT TOUCH!
326 int _numDofs = 0;
327
328 // [Internal] Joint indices that are DOFS; computed at runtime by RebuildBotData; DO NOT TOUCH!
329 DynamicArray<int> _dofIndices;
330
331 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotPrefab)
332 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
333 MOCHI_FIELD(joints) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
334 MOCHI_FIELD(links) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
335 MOCHI_FIELD(worldFromRoot) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
336 MOCHI_FIELD(defaultPose) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
337 MOCHI_FIELD(linearTransmissions) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
338 MOCHI_FIELD(spatialTendons) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
339 MOCHI_FIELD(contactOverrides) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults(/*recursive*/ false));
340 MOCHI_FIELD(cycles) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
341 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
342};

470/**
471 * @brief Runtime interface to a bot instance in a @ref Scene.
472 *
473 * @details A @ref Bot wraps a single articulated @ref Actor with the controllers, sensors, and
474 * actuators created for it. Bots are created via @ref CreateBot and destroyed via @ref DestroyBot.
475 * The @ref RoboticsContext owns the bot memory allocated and deallocated by these functions,
476 * respectively. The raw @ref Bot* returned by @ref CreateBot remains valid until @ref DestroyBot
477 * is called or the @ref RoboticsContext is destroyed.
478 *
479 * @note Not thread-safe -- like the underlying @ref Scene, a @ref Bot must only be accessed
480 * from the thread that owns its scene (usually in an async callback if using async scenes.)
481 */
482class MOCHI_API Bot {
483 public:
484 /** @brief Handle identifying this bot in its owning @ref RoboticsContext.
485 * @return Handle identifying this bot. */
486 [[nodiscard]] virtual BotHandle GetHandle() const = 0;
487
488 /** @brief The Mochi @ref Context that owns this bot's scene.
489 * @return Mochi context that owns this bot's scene. */
490 [[nodiscard]] virtual Context* GetMochiContext() = 0;
491 /** @copydoc GetMochiContext */
492 [[nodiscard]] virtual Context const* GetMochiContext() const = 0;
493
494 /** @brief The @ref RoboticsContext that owns this bot.
495 * @return Robotics context that owns this bot. */
496 [[nodiscard]] virtual RoboticsContext* GetBotContext() = 0;
497 /** @copydoc GetBotContext */
498 [[nodiscard]] virtual RoboticsContext const* GetBotContext() const = 0;
499
500 /** @brief The @ref Scene in which this bot was created.
501 * @return Owning scene, or nullptr if it no longer exists. */
502 [[nodiscard]] virtual Scene* GetScene() = 0;
503 /** @copydoc GetScene */
504 [[nodiscard]] virtual Scene const* GetScene() const = 0;
505
506 /** @brief Bot name (forwarded from @ref BotPrefab::name).
507 * @return Null-terminated bot name. */
508 [[nodiscard]] virtual char const* GetName() const = 0;
509
510 /** @brief The @ref BotPrefab from which this bot was created.
511 * @return Prefab used to create this bot. */
512 [[nodiscard]] virtual BotPrefab const& GetBotPrefab() const = 0;
513
514 /** @brief The underlying articulated @ref Actor that backs this bot in the scene.
515 * @return Underlying articulated actor, or nullptr if it no longer exists. */
516 [[nodiscard]] virtual Actor* GetArticulatedActor() const = 0;
517
518 /**
519 * @brief Create a controller of the given type and attach it to this bot.
520 *
521 * @param[in] typeName Registered controller type (e.g., @c "BASIC_OSC_PD", @c "BASIC_JSC_PD").
522 * @param[in] name Instance name for the controller, used by @ref FindControllersByName. Names
523 * need not be unique.
524 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
525 * @return Pointer to the new controller, or nullptr on error.
526 */
527 [[nodiscard]] virtual ControllerBase*
528 CreateController(std::string_view typeName, std::string_view name, superdex::Error& error) = 0;
529
530 /**
531 * @brief Get the handles of every controller this bot owns.
532 *
533 * @details Covers controllers created through @ref CreateController and those created on one of
534 * this bot's actors with @ref RoboticsContext::CreateController — the owning bot is inferred from
535 * the actor (see @ref RoboticsContext::GetBotContainingActor), so how a controller was created
536 * makes no difference to whether it appears here. Mirrors @ref GetSensorHandles
537 * "GetSensorHandles": the same set the bot-scoped finders draw from, and the same set
538 * @ref DestroyBot tears down. Resolve each handle with @ref RoboticsContext::GetController.
539 *
540 * @return A snapshot of the bot's controller handles, in creation order.
541 */
542 [[nodiscard]] virtual DynamicArray<ControllerHandle> GetControllerHandles() const = 0;
543
544 /**
545 * @brief Resolve a controller handle to its underlying @ref ControllerBase.
546 *
547 * @details Unlike @ref RoboticsContext::GetController, which resolves any handle in the context,
548 * this checks the controller belongs to this bot first — so a handle from another bot, or from a
549 * standalone actor, is reported as an error rather than silently resolved.
550 *
551 * @param[in] controllerHandle Handle returned by @ref GetControllerHandles.
552 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Set if the handle is invalid or does not belong to this bot.
553 * @return Pointer to the controller, or nullptr on error.
554 */
555 [[nodiscard]] virtual ControllerBase* GetController(
556 ControllerHandle controllerHandle,
557 superdex::Error& error) const = 0;
558
559 /**
560 * @brief Create a sensor of the given type on one of this bot's links.
561 *
562 * @details The bot-level counterpart to declaring a @ref BotSensorPrefab in the @ref BotPrefab,
563 * for sensors that are only known at runtime. The sensor joins @ref GetSensorHandles and is
564 * destroyed with the bot, exactly like an auto-instantiated one.
565 *
566 * @param[in] typeName Registered sensor type (e.g. @c "SENSOR_CAMERA").
567 * @param[in] linkName Name of the link (from @ref BotPrefab::links) to attach the sensor to.
568 * @param[in] name Instance name, used by @ref FindSensorsByName. Names need not be unique.
569 * @param[in] paramArgs Optional params file path or inline JSON; empty uses defaults.
570 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
571 * @return Pointer to the new sensor, or nullptr on error.
572 */
573 [[nodiscard]] virtual SensorBase* CreateSensor(
574 std::string_view typeName,
575 std::string_view linkName,
576 std::string_view name,
577 std::string_view paramArgs,
578 superdex::Error& error) = 0;
579
580 /**
581 * @brief Get the handles of every sensor this bot owns.
582 *
583 * @details Covers sensors declared per link in the @ref BotPrefab via @ref BotSensorPrefab and
584 * instantiated by @ref CreateBot, those added afterwards via @ref CreateSensor, and those
585 * created straight off one of this bot's actors with @ref RoboticsContext::CreateSensor — the
586 * owning bot is inferred from the actor (see @ref RoboticsContext::GetBotContainingActor), so
587 * how a sensor was created makes no difference to whether it appears here. This is the same set
588 * the bot-scoped finders draw from, and the same set @ref DestroyBot tears down. Use
589 * @ref RoboticsContext::GetSensor on each handle to obtain the underlying @ref SensorBase
590 * pointer.
591 *
592 * @return A snapshot of the bot's sensor handles in creation order: the @ref BotPrefab::links
593 * entries first (by link, then by per-link sensor index), followed by any later additions.
594 */
595 [[nodiscard]] virtual DynamicArray<SensorHandle> GetSensorHandles() const = 0;
596
597 /**
598 * @brief Resolve a sensor handle to its underlying @ref SensorBase.
599 * @param[in] sensorHandle Handle returned by @ref GetSensorHandles.
600 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Set if the handle is invalid or does not belong to this bot.
601 * @return Pointer to the sensor, or nullptr on error.
602 */
603 [[nodiscard]] virtual SensorBase* GetSensor(SensorHandle sensorHandle, superdex::Error& error)
604 const = 0;
605
606 /**
607 * @brief Get the name of the link to which the sensor is attached.
608 * @param[in] sensorHandle Handle returned by @ref GetSensorHandles.
609 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Set if the handle does not belong to this bot.

708/**
709 * @brief Create a new @ref RoboticsContext.
710 *
711 * @details The returned @ref RoboticsContext owns all bots, controllers, sensors, and actuators
712 * created through it. Destroy with @ref DestroyRoboticsContext.
713 *
714 * @return Pointer to the new @ref RoboticsContext.
715 */
716MOCHI_API RoboticsContext* CreateRoboticsContext(); // NOLINT(readability-redundant-declaration)
717
718/**
719 * @brief Destroy a @ref RoboticsContext previously created by @ref CreateRoboticsContext.
720 *
721 * @details Destroys all bots, controllers, sensors, and actuators owned by the context. No-op if
722 * @p ctx is null.
723 *
724 * @param[in] ctx Bots context to destroy.
725 */
726MOCHI_API void DestroyRoboticsContext(
727 RoboticsContext* ctx); // NOLINT(readability-redundant-declaration)
728
729/**
730 * @brief Load bot parameters from a .superdex_bot file using the default file-based loader.
731 * Automatically resolves @ref ModBotPrefab files by building the final @ref BotPrefab.
732 *
733 * If @p path is a `.superdex_bot_archive` file (see @ref ArchiveBot), the archive is
734 * transparently extracted and cached into a temp directory and the embedded target bot is loaded.
735 *
736 * @param[in] path File path to the `.superdex_bot` or `.superdex_bot_archive` file.
737 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
738 * @return Loaded or built @ref BotPrefab, or default-constructed on failure.
739 */
740MOCHI_API BotPrefab LoadBotPrefabFromFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error);
741
742/**
743 * @brief Create a @ref Bot runtime object from a @ref BotPrefab. Builds the underlying
744 * articulated actor in @p scene and seeds its default pose. The returned @ref Bot owns no
745 * scene resources beyond the actor — destroy it with @ref DestroyBot. This must be in the scene
746 * thread (i.e. in an async callback if using async scenes.)
747 *
748 * @param[in] scene Target scene in which to create the bot and its components.
749 * @param[in] botPrefab Bot parameters describing the articulation.
750 * @param[in] botsContext Bots context used for components created on the bot. Must
751 * outlive the returned @ref Bot.
752 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
753 * @return Pointer to the created @ref Bot.
754 */
755MOCHI_API Bot* CreateBot(
756 Scene* scene,
757 BotPrefab const& botPrefab,
758 RoboticsContext* botsContext,
759 superdex::Error& error);
760
761/**
762 * @brief Destroy a @ref Bot previously created by @ref CreateBot. Destroys the underlying
763 * articulated actor in its owning scene and any controllers, sensors, and actuators the bot
764 * created. This must be in the scene thread (i.e. in an async callback if using async scenes.)
765 *
766 * @param[in] scene Scene to remove the bot from. Must be the same scene used to create the bot.
767 * @param[in] bot Pointer to the bot to be destroyed.
768 */
769MOCHI_API void DestroyBot(Scene* scene, Bot* bot);
